collection.title: Lotus Europa 2006 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Lotus Europa 2006 to 2010 requires a 26" wiper blade, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
